title: Gives New Life to an Old Bed!
text: Gives New Life to an Old Bed!. This gel mattress topper gives new life to an old bed! It adds 3 inches to the height of the bed. It arrived compressed. I took it out of the packaging and let it expand for a few days. I didn't notice any bad chemical smells when I opened it, but by the time I checked on it a few days later, there was no smell at all. It's very comfortable.

product_metadata.title: Twin Mattress Topper 3 Inch Memory Foam Topper, Cooling Gel Egg Crate Foam Bed Topper, Marine Moon High-Density Mattress Topper, Removable Soft Cover
features: 🔹Instantly Improve Any Mattress: A 3-inch mattress topper is a perfect addition to a mattress, which could add softness and offer extra support. You will not make excessive sinking. Memory foam mattress topper stays true to your body’s needs with a weightless comfort that feels like you’re sleeping on a cloud. Get amazing comfort for less money and extend the life of your mattress!

🔹Cooler Restful Sleep: Cooling gel-infused memory foam and the ups and downs egg crate foam structure design can improve breathability and airflow, keep you cool all night. Cooling Mattress topper maximizes comfort regulation for the restorative sleep possible. In addition, we added a moisture-absorbing thin cover between the outer cover and the 3-inch memory foam. The double-layer cover can effectively reduce the memory foam tears and play a double protection role for gel memory foam.

🔹Total Pressure Point Relief: Highly- Adaptive memory foam conforms to the curves of your body, distributes weight evenly to align the spine, and provides the best relief and support for the pressure points like your shoulders, back, and hips. The breathable gel mattress topper reduces your body burden effectively and stays cool this summer.

🔹Washable Non-slip Cover: Adopting the latest weaving technology, Our removable & machine washable cover is soft to touch and with high durability. The back of the cover is evenly distributed with small non-slip particles. And this twin bed mattress topper has 4 elastic straps adapting to mattress depths up to 18", which can help the extra thick bed topper stay securely in place throughout the night.

🔹30-Night Trial: Before first use, please leave the soft mattress topper flatly in a well-ventilated area for 48-72 hours until it’s fully expanded. It is normal for the new foam to have a slight smell, and the egg crate mattress topper will dissipate within 72 hours. We are 24/7 available to answer your questions. Take the cooling mattress topper a trial with no risk!
